title: Local-first research assistant
description: A small project that indexes private notes locally and exposes inspectable retrieval steps.
content: The project combines local embeddings, a content-addressed cache, and a transparent retrieval log so every answer can be traced back to a source note.

title: garden-parser
description: An example repository that normalizes Markdown, JSON, and feed entries into one content contract.
content: The repository focuses on adapters, deterministic tests, and a deliberately small public API.

title: After the index
description: A short poem about finding an unexpected path between two distant notes.
content: After the index closes, a small path remains between the rain and an unfinished machine.
